summaries.plain:
Completed and validated major billing, search, export, and operational improvements. CLI billing-filter normalization, billing-worker retention, webhook retries, and billing typing are done. Search rebuilds now share an `EmbeddingClient`, use transactional bulk upserts, and enforce unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` records; benchmarking showed 10,000 documents dropping from 16.73s to 2.41s. CSV export UTF-8 regressions pass. Redis cluster health is confirmed across all slots, and a 4.2 GB backup was written.

Billing helpers, generator handling, Decimal-normalized discounts, and Decimal/account/timezone-aware ledger posting are complete. MyPy and diff/whitespace checks are clean. Full-suite runtime fell to roughly 15 seconds; invoice tests dropped to about 1.1 seconds.

A flaky invoice-sync integration test was investigated. Repeated concurrent execution exposed a stale `idempotency_keys` row remaining in `processing` after a successful request. The repository now guards completion by ensuring the stored invoice ID matches, transitions the key to `completed`, and returns the existing result. All 8 invoice-sync integration tests now pass.

Still relevant: explicitly verify the credit-after-refund calculation previously returning `90.00` instead of `87.50`, add dunning pause/resume regression coverage, implement safe customer-account merging with identifier-conflict detection, and rebase/squash task branches when ready. Log-rate limit remains 10 percentage points with existing approval requirements. On-call reviewer: **@elif**.
